name: Cooler Walks
androidShortDescription: Plan walking routes with shade, sun, water and quieter streets.
description:
Cooler Walks compares walking routes within your extra-time limit. Choose shade or sun, then add preferences for calmer streets, water or flatter paths where the data supports them.

Search an address, select points on the map or use your location. Add up to three stops, choose a departure time and allow up to 15 extra minutes. English and German share the same planner. Download supported areas to plan offline.

COVERAGE
Zurich is the primary area: 57.77 km² with municipal pavement geometry, address search, experimental building and tree shade, terrain profiles and historical traffic-count evidence. Munich remains beta: 40.5 km² across central Munich and adjoining districts, with 3D building shade, ground elevation, calmer streets, mapped barriers and partial address search. Munich tree shade and complete pavement-side coverage are still open. Basel and Cambridge, Massachusetts, remain greenery and water-proximity pilots. The actual coverage boundaries are visible.

ESTIMATES
Shade estimates obstruction of direct sunlight at the expected time of passing. Clouds and terrain-cast shadows are not included. Tree shade is available in Zurich only. Greenery and water proximity are separate indicators, not proof of shade or cooling. Traffic preferences use mapped street context, not live vehicle counts or noise measurements. Avoiding recorded barriers does not establish wheelchair suitability. Local access and conditions may differ.

PRIVACY
Routing and search use downloaded data on your device. Location is optional. Precise journey history is not saved. Website and data downloads contact the host. See the privacy notice for details.
reviewNotes: Version 0.24.0 / build 24. Select Munich (beta), set 21 June 2026 at 14:00 Europe/Berlin and allow five extra minutes. Switching Shade/Sun selects different routes for the default journey. Test flatter routes, calm streets, water and mapped-barrier avoidance together; adjust the extra-time slider to seven minutes. Search Marienplatz 1 and Residenzstraße 1; also plan Hohenzollernplatz to Münchner Freiheit in the expanded area. Download the full Munich area, reload offline and repeat. Munich covers 40.5 km² and models building shade only, using Bavarian LoD2 roofs/facades and DGM1 ground heights. Tree shade, complete pavement geometry, comprehensive accessibility and Munich vehicle counts are not yet available. Zurich includes its existing building/tree models and historical vehicle-count evidence. These models await field validation; no live traffic, weather or thermal-comfort claim. The website is currently password-protected; no public store submission is authorized or ready. Native full builds bundle all four cities, but remote updates from the protected host require a separate access solution. Android emulator and desktop Chrome installed-PWA checks passed; physical-device and current iOS interaction tests remain open. No account is needed inside the planner.
